title: Bonded Loft
summary: Start: enter Ledger. The log opens Bonded Loft and the helm marks the Bond Factor. Do: come within 320 meters of the Bond Factor. The factor slides alongside and reads the bond in public. The warehouse patrol hails. Sealing a layer is the separate Ledger contract. Finish: after the factor is met, come inside Bonded Loft's shell. The Compact writes standing. Fail: there is no timer. Leave and the job stays open until you close. The shell alone does not file it.
